'''Situational Enforcement''' was a branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. They were responsible for analyzing crime patterns throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] as a whole. [[Situational Enforcements Officer]]s monitor transmissions and broadcasts, analyzes data and forensics, and cataloged [[Security camera/Legends|security camera]] footage. Situational Enforcement had three branches; [[Transit Procedures]], which was tasked with handling investigations concerning shipping and commerce; [[Material Procedures]], charged with tracking incidents of property damage to equipment and facilities; and [[Information Procedures]], which worked with [[Operational Multisystem Management]] to preserve the security of the Authority's data transmissions.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
